title: Yu-Kim-Hakim-Murnaghan Extension to Even Orthogonal Groups
body_html:
Yu-Kim-Hakim-Murnaghan Extension to Even Orthogonal Groups

For \(G=O(V)\) with \(V\) even-dimensional, the datum construction still gives irreducible supercuspidal representations, these representations exhaust the supercuspidal spectrum under the same large-\(p\) hypotheses, and the same equivalence relation on data classifies isomorphism classes.
proof_html:
Extraction

The paper reduces to the connected special orthogonal subgroup. Depth-zero types are handled by Clifford theory for an index-two normal subgroup. Twisted Levi subgroups and genericity conditions extend because the centralizers are products of classical factors, and the required Yu conditions SC1-SC3 are checked using the same arguments as in the connected case, with the Heisenberg-Weil extension supplied by Appendix A.2. Exhaustion and equivalence are then lifted from the connected group and the two restriction cases for \(O(V)\).
